race.description: Jarrod Arentz Electrical & Solar Solutions Mdn Plate
race.comment: HELLS GATES (4) was well in the market on debut last start over 1200m at Ballarat when fourth, beaten just 1.3 lengths. Started hard in the market off some good trials leading into that, so if he's taken any improvement from that he'll go close. BIG STORM (1) worked home well and finished second last time over 1175m at Albury, beaten just over half-a-length. Will trim down following recent racing and looks placed to advantage. MISS VERONA (12) has been in the betting recently but has failed to break through. Most recently finished fifth over 1200m at Echuca, beaten 4 lengths. Can feature in the finish. SAN MARCO KID (3) has done nothing to date and draws out, but is with a new stable and recent trials suggest an improved run could be on the cards.
